description: Combine patches into one tree, resolving overlaps explicitly and verifying the combined result.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: What the task must achieve, from the task record.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Conditions the result is checked against.

outputs.name: integratedTree
outputs.description: The combined change with a passing test receipt.

steps.description: Read each patch and the base files it targets. Note which patches touch the same lines.
Apply patches one at a time against current hashes. When two overlap, combine their intent by hand; never drop one silently.
Run the registered tests on the combined result.
steps.evidence: A passing test.run receipt for the combined revision.

steps.description: Write down each conflict, how it was resolved, and which behavior each patch contributed.
